India Rejects UN Human Rights Claims as Political Pressure

India has rejected claims made at the UN Human Rights Council, stating that human rights should not be used for political pressure or to portray the country negatively through unverified allegations. This response comes as UN experts raised concerns regarding police actions during youth-led protests. India asserted that attempts to defame democracy under the guise of human rights would be met with a strong response.
